v: San Francisco Measure H (November 3, 2026): new annual parcel tax for Muni, $129 per parcel up to $400,000 depending on property type and size, inflation-adjusted, for 15 years; YES 74.4% in the preliminary count updated November 10, 2026 (needs 50%+1)
q: MEASURE H - PARCEL TAX TO FUND MUNI OPERATIONS ... Shall the City fund Muni service through a new annual parcel tax on real estate at rates ranging from $129 per parcel up to a maximum of $400,000 per parcel, depending on the type of property and its size and adjusted annually for inflation, for estimated revenue of $177 million a year for 15 years? ... This measure required 50%+1 affirmative votes to pass. YES | 244,760 | 74.4%
